en.name: Alexander VIII
en.summary: An elderly Venetian pope whose brief sixteen-month reign was notable mainly for reconciling with Louis XIV and for open nepotism toward his own family.
en.body: Pietro Ottoboni was eighty years old at his election and used his short pontificate to restore relations with France, strained under his predecessor, while also granting extensive wealth and offices to his relatives. He condemned certain Gallican propositions asserted by the French clergy, reasserting papal authority, but his reign was too brief to leave much further mark before his death in 1691.

fr.name: Alexandre VIII
fr.summary: Un pape vénitien âgé dont le bref règne de seize mois fut surtout marqué par la réconciliation avec Louis XIV et un népotisme ouvert envers sa propre famille.
fr.body: Pietro Ottoboni avait quatre-vingts ans à son élection et employa son court pontificat à restaurer les relations avec la France, tendues sous son prédécesseur, tout en accordant une richesse et des charges considérables à ses proches. Il condamna certaines propositions gallicanes affirmées par le clergé français, réaffirmant l'autorité papale, mais son règne fut trop bref pour laisser une marque plus profonde avant sa mort en 1691.
